faq.q: What payment methods do you accept for yacht charters in Marbella in 2028?
faq.a: We accept credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), bank transfers to our Spanish IBAN account, and cash (up to €1,000 per transaction as per Spanish law). For Tier A boats (€749-€2,299) and Tier B boats (€4,719+), we require a 30-50% deposit to confirm the booking.

faq.q: How much deposit is required to book a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: A deposit of 30-50% of the total charter cost is required to secure your booking. For Tier A boats like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, that's roughly €225-€375 for a 2-hour trip. For Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80, the deposit is €1,416-€2,360. The balance is due 7 days before departure or can be paid in cash on the day.

faq.q: Can I pay by credit card for a yacht charter in Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Yes, we accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Card payments are processed securely via our booking system. There are no additional surcharges for card use. You can pay the deposit by card online and the balance by card or bank transfer before the trip.

faq.q: Is there a cash limit for yacht charter payments in Spain in 2028?
faq.a: Yes, in Spain cash payments are limited to €1,000 per transaction. For charters costing more than that (most of our boats), you'll need to pay the balance by card or bank transfer. The deposit can also be paid by card or transfer to stay within legal limits.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Marbella yacht charters?
faq.a: Cancellations made 14+ days before departure receive a full refund minus a 5% admin fee. Cancellations 7-13 days before forfeit 50% of the deposit. Cancellations less than 7 days before are non-refundable. We recommend travel insurance for peace of mind.

faq.q: Do I need to pay the full amount upfront for a yacht charter?
faq.a: No, only a 30-50% deposit is required to confirm your booking. The remaining balance is due 7 days before your charter date. For last-minute bookings (within 7 days), full payment is required at the time of booking. We'll send you a payment link or bank details.

faq.q: Can I pay by bank transfer from a non-EU account?
faq.a: Yes, we accept international bank transfers in EUR to our Spanish IBAN account. Please note that your bank may charge fees for SWIFT transfers, and processing can take 2-5 business days. We recommend transferring at least 5 days before the deposit deadline to avoid delays.

faq.q: What happens if I need to change the date of my charter?
faq.a: Date changes are free of charge up to 7 days before the original charter date, subject to availability. After that, a €100 admin fee applies. We'll do our best to accommodate your new date, especially during peak summer months in Puerto Banús.

data.body_html:
Planning a marbella yacht charter payment methods 2028 guide? You've come to the right place. Whether you're booking the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h), understanding how to pay, what deposit is needed, and the cancellation terms ensures a smooth experience. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Here's everything you need to know about payments for 2028.

Payment Methods Accepted

We accept three payment methods for all yacht charters in Marbella:

  • Credit/Debit Cards – Visa, Mastercard, American Express. No surcharges. Secure online payment link provided after booking.
  • Bank Transfer – Direct transfer in EUR to our Spanish IBAN account. Include your booking reference. Allow 2-5 business days for international transfers.
  • Cash – Limited to €1,000 per transaction under Spanish law (2028). Only suitable for deposits on smaller boats or final balances on Tier A charters.

For boats with pricing on request (e.g., Ferretti 94, Azimut 58 Flybridge), contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote and payment plan.

Deposit Requirements

A deposit of 30-50% of the total charter cost is required to secure your booking. Here's how it breaks down by boat tier:

Boat TierExample BoatsPrice RangeDeposit (30-50%)
Tier AAstondoa 40, Azimut 39€749/2h – €2,299/8h€225 – €1,150
Tier BMangusta 80 (white/grey)€4,719/4h minimum€1,416 – €2,360
OtherFerretti 94, Canados 86, etc.On requestNegotiable

The balance is due 7 days before departure. For last-minute bookings (within 7 days), full payment is required at booking.

Cancellation Policy

Our cancellation terms are straightforward:

  • 14+ days before charter: Full refund minus 5% admin fee.
  • 7-13 days before charter: 50% of deposit forfeited.
  • Less than 7 days: No refund.
  • Date changes: Free up to 7 days before; €100 fee after.

We recommend travel insurance that covers trip cancellation, especially for summer charters in Puerto Banús.

Bank Transfer Details

For bank transfers, use the following details (provided after booking):

  • Beneficiary: Boat Rental Marbella SL
  • IBAN: ESxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx
  • SWIFT/BIC: XXXXXXXX
  • Reference: Your booking number

Transfers from non-EU banks may incur intermediary fees; please send the exact amount in EUR to avoid shortfalls. For questions, contact us via our main page.

What's Included in Your Charter Price

Every charter from our fleet includes:

  • Licensed skipper (no extra cost)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – already in the price

No hidden fees. What you see is what you pay.
